exposure: primary or secondary urinary diversion (UD) after cystectomy
outcome: pain or discomfort during sexual intercourse (dyspareunia)
cohort: The study included 21 adult females (mean age 26 years) with exstrophy-epispadias complex (EEC) recruited from the German multicenter network for congenital uro-rectal malformations (CURE-Net).
finding: Total FSFI values (<26.55) in female EEC patients indicate a risk of sexual dysfunction, with incontinence and introitus plasty potentially playing an additional role, and females reconstructed with urinary diversion seemingly having better sexual function.
cross-section timing: Adult females aged 18 years or older at the time of the survey.
